pass_condition: Verified permission and SHA-256 bytes from primary source
All in-scope source identities explicitly reviewed/approved
>=730-day span and >=80% observed per eligible series, temporal split
Observed source-backed arrivals where claimed, unit/date verified
Site-level consented GNSS with evidence, reviewed accuracy threshold
Source-backed nodes/edges, routing tests, real distance
Height/weight restrictions verified or mandatory operator signoff for unknowns
Fresh confirmed time window, non-overlap, capacity and quote
Verified receipt, scale and custody for every pilot lot
Authorized buyer offer terms, signature and expiry validated
Operator confirms compatible capacity in time window
Calibrated timestamped sensor data if sensor decisions claimed
Authenticated provider credit + ledger reconciliation; UTR-only rejected
Source-issued timestamp and validated crop-risk rule
Temporal backtests, baseline gain and per-series results without leakage
Reviewed data access, consent, deletion/retention and audit evidence
Offline capture, sync conflict and replay tested
Successful restore, incident exercise and alert evidence
Pre-registered small shadow pilot with real evidence and reconciliation
Re-run repo test suite, reproduce >=176 historical tests if present
Readiness remains blocked until every mandatory field gate is verified
Canonical release archive signature/hash reconciled or per-file equivalence documented and approved
failure_policy: Do not sign off canonical release
